name: scientific-visualization
description: Perceptually and cognitively grounded guidance for designing and reviewing scientific figures, tables, diagrams, and other visual displays of data. Synthesized from Ware (2020) Information Visualization 4th ed. and Schloss (2025) Annual Review of Vision Science. Use when creating new visualizations, choosing chart types, selecting color palettes, reviewing figure quality, auditing accessibility, or evaluating any scientific display for adherence to perception research best practices. Supports two modes: design (proactive guidance for new visualizations) and review (systematic audit of existing ones).
